name: Vellore Institute of Technology
summary: VIT was founded in 1984 as Vellore Engineering College, a self-financing institution, and was granted deemed-university status in 2001. It now offers BTech, BCA, BBA, BDes and postgraduate programs across engineering and allied fields, with admission and fee category driven by its own entrance exam and counselling process.

applicationPlatform.value: VITEEE online application, then VIT's online counselling, which allots campus, programme and fee category by VITEEE rank. NRI/foreign applicants apply separately.

testing.notes: Indian applicants; NRI/foreign applicants use the international route.

internationalTuition.notes: Charged in US dollars (US$9,000 per year for B.Tech in 2026-27) — shown in the fee breakdown rather than converted.

domesticTuition.notes: B.Tech CSE (Group B), per year, by fee category allotted at counselling: Cat 1 ₹1,95,000 · Cat 2 ₹3,04,000 · Cat 3 ₹4,02,000 · Cat 4 ₹4,45,000 · Cat 5 ₹4,90,000. scholarships.name: GV School Development Programme (VITEEE rank)
scholarships.coverage: Ranks 1–10: 100% tuition waiver; 11–50: 75%; 51–100: 50%; 101–500: 25% — for four years.

housing.value: Residential Vellore campus with separate men's and women's hostel zones (AC and non-AC, single and shared rooms) housing over 22,000 students.

admissionProcess.detail: Class XII with 60% aggregate in PCM and at least 50% in Mathematics.
Register for VITEEE-2026 and sit the computer-based test.
Choose campus and programme by VITEEE rank; the fee category (1–5) is allotted with the seat.
NRI and foreign nationals apply through VIT's international admissions with separate eligibility and USD fees.
